newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 13.

text.p: * American General Corp said it had agreed to acquire USLIFE Corp in a stock deal valued at $1.8 billion. American General closed at 41-1/2 Wednesday. USLife closed at 41-3/4.

* Pilots of AMR Corp's American Airlines, who have threatened to go on strike at midnight Friday, are prepared to bargain on the key issue of pay for pilots of regional commuter jets, according to a source close to the negotiations. AMR closed at 82-7/8.
* Harvard Industries Inc said after the close of trading Wednesday that it expected to report a net loss for the current quarter and for the year ending September 30. Shares closed at 2-1/16.
* PictureTel Corp shares stood at 18-3/8 in after-hours trading Wednesday, down slightly from their close at 18-9/16 after the company reported higher 1996 fourth quarter results.
